source_question: Hi Jorge， I run a new report with latest FTTH coverage infomation, could you aprrove it
core: Hi Jorge, I generated a new report using the latest FTTH coverage information. Could you please approve it?
meaning_cn: 嗨，Jorge，我使用最新的 FTTH 覆盖信息生成了一份新报告。你能审批一下吗？
explanation_cn: 描述已经完成的动作时用过去式 generated，而不是 run。using the latest FTTH coverage information 明确说明报告所用数据；information 不可数，前面通常不加 a。Could you please approve it? 是简洁、礼貌的审批请求。注意 information 和 approve 的拼写。
source_sentence: Hi Jorge, I run a new report with latest FTTH coverage infomation, could you aprrove it.

examples.en: I generated a new report using the latest customer data. Could you please review it?
examples.cn: 我使用最新的客户数据生成了一份新报告。你能审阅一下吗？

examples.en: I prepared the updated FTTH coverage report. Could you please approve it?
examples.cn: 我准备好了更新后的 FTTH 覆盖报告。你能审批一下吗？

examples.en: The report has been updated with the latest coverage information and is ready for approval.
examples.cn: 报告已使用最新覆盖信息完成更新，可以提交审批。

pronunciation.text: Hi Jorge, I generated a new report using the latest FTTH coverage information. Could you please approve it?
pronunciation.hint_cn: generated、latest、coverage 和 approve 承担主要信息重音；Could you please 可连读并保持礼貌语气。

source_question: Morning Danelis, I can get my visa today, right（直接问大概什么时候能拿到）
core: Good morning, Danelis. Around what time can I pick up my visa today?
meaning_cn: 早上好，Danelis。我今天大概几点可以去领取签证？
explanation_cn: 询问当天大概几点可以领取某物时，用 Around what time can I...? 比 I can get... right? 更直接、自然。领取签证强调本人去取，使用 pick up my visa 比 get my visa 更准确；today 放在句末即可。
source_sentence: Morning Danelis, I can get my visa today, right?

examples.en: Around what time can I pick up the documents today?
examples.cn: 我今天大概几点可以去领取这些文件？

examples.en: Do you know around what time my visa will be ready?
examples.cn: 你知道我的签证大概几点能准备好吗？

examples.en: What time would be convenient for me to come by and pick it up?
examples.cn: 我大概几点过去领取比较方便？

pronunciation.text: Good morning, Danelis. Around what time can I pick up my visa today?
pronunciation.hint_cn: Around what time、pick up 和 today 承担主要信息重音；pick up 连读，语调保持礼貌、自然。

meaning_cn: 固定宽带渗透率正接近 50%。
explanation_cn: penetration 的拼写中间是 -tra-，不是 penetetion。表达某个比例接近但尚未达到某值时，is approaching 50% 比省略谓语的 nearly 50% 更完整，适合作为图表结论或正文；若作为极短标签，也可写 FBB penetration: nearly 50%。

examples.en: Fiber penetration is approaching 60% in the largest cities.
examples.cn: 最大城市的光纤渗透率正接近 60%。

examples.en: Household broadband penetration is now close to 50%.
examples.cn: 家庭宽带渗透率目前已接近 50%。

examples.en: FBB penetration remains below the regional average.
examples.cn: 固定宽带渗透率仍低于区域平均水平。

pronunciation.hint_cn: penetration 重音在 -tra- 所在音节；approaching 和 fifty 承担主要信息重音。

source_question: Near parity with Tigo, but no clear speed advantage
core: Near parity with Tigo, but no clear speed advantage.
meaning_cn: 与 Tigo 基本持平，但没有明显的速率优势。
explanation_cn: near parity with 表示与某个对手或基准接近持平，适合图表标题和短结论。no clear speed advantage 比 no obvious advantage in speed 更简洁。该表达是标题式短语；若写完整句，可用 Performance is near parity with Tigo, but there is no clear speed advantage。
source_sentence: Near parity with Tigo, but no clear speed advantage

examples.en: Pricing is near parity with Tigo, but Claro offers fewer promotions.
examples.cn: 资费与 Tigo 基本持平，但 Claro 的促销更少。

examples.en: Coverage is close to parity, with no clear quality advantage.
examples.cn: 覆盖已接近持平，但没有明显的质量优势。

examples.en: Claro has reached near parity in average speed, but not clear leadership.
examples.cn: Claro 的平均速率已接近持平，但尚未形成明确领先。

pronunciation.text: Near parity with Tigo, but no clear speed advantage.
pronunciation.hint_cn: parity 的首音节重读；clear、speed 和 advantage 承担对比信息重音。

source_question: Market Growth Slows, Customer Experience Becomes Keyto Subscriber Growth
core: As market growth slows, customer experience becomes a key driver of subscriber growth.
meaning_cn: 随着市场增长放缓，客户体验成为用户增长的关键驱动力。
explanation_cn: key to 不能连写为 keyto。为了明确两部分之间的逻辑关系，用 As market growth slows 引出背景；a key driver of subscriber growth 比 becomes key to subscriber growth 更自然，也更像观点型商业标题。若数据不能证明因果，可将 driver 改为 differentiator，表达体验成为关键差异点。
source_sentence: Market Growth Slows, Customer Experience Becomes Keyto Subscriber Growth

examples.en: As subscriber growth slows, service quality becomes a key competitive differentiator.
examples.cn: 随着用户增长放缓，服务质量成为关键竞争差异点。

examples.en: Customer experience is becoming increasingly important for subscriber acquisition.
examples.cn: 客户体验对用户获取正变得越来越重要。

examples.en: In a mature market, experience can matter more than headline speed.
examples.cn: 在成熟市场中，体验可能比标称速率更重要。

pronunciation.text: As market growth slows, customer experience becomes a key driver of subscriber growth.
pronunciation.hint_cn: market growth、customer experience、key driver 和 subscriber growth 承担主要信息重音。
